title: Jets expect injured Breece Hall to be ready to play Week 1

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets expect injured Breece Hall to be ready to play Week 1
sources.description: Breece Hall suffered a minor groin injury in Jets practice on Monday. Head coach Aaron Glenn did not sound very concerned initially.
